verdicts.reason: A: the orange divider rule runs straight through the body copy ('and released'), a clear unwanted collision. The dark brand panel takes about 40% of the width but holds only a tiny logo, leaving a lot of dead space. The body copy is pushed right and does not line up with the centred headline. B: the panel is narrower and the logo is properly sized. Its flaws are the orphaned 'Evenings' on its own line, a divider stuck at the left edge instead of under the centred headline, a left-aligned CTA against centred text, and 'Ships late June' floating loose from the button.
